title: Glas poduzetnika rally for compensation and economic-policy changes

location.site: Main square / Trg bana Josipa Jelačića

organizer: Glas poduzetnika (as reported in the opened Index coverage)

threshold_50_evidence: Opened Index live coverage describes thousands at the rally, which clearly exceeds the threshold qualitatively; no precise numerical bounds are established. Search-only estimates are not independent confirmation.

start_date.summary: Opened live report is dated February3 and places the rally on that date.

location.summary: Opened report places the rally in central Zagreb at the main square; exact boundary of the gathering is not established.

organizer.summary: Index identifies the Glas poduzetnika entrepreneurs’ association as rally organizer.

demands.summary: Opened report lists fair compensation, repeal of parafiscal charges and mandatory chamber membership, and a demand that Economy Minister Tomislav Ćorić resign. Demand-category mapping remains provisional pending official baseline.

participants.summary: Index body says “thousands”; 24sata and 24ur are search-only previews, with 24ur preview attributing a 5,000 estimate to organizers. Do not treat previews as separate body-confirmed counts.

protester_violence.summary: The reviewed passages do not establish protester violence or its absence.

end_date.summary: Timeline says the crowd began leaving shortly after noon; it does not establish the final participant’s departure or event closure.

state_response.summary: The reviewed passages do not establish a coded event-specific response; all seven fields remain unknown.

notes: Provisional event candidate based on opened contemporaneous coverage. The event is distinct from the January30 hospitality-owner carpark meeting; no continuity is inferred. Economic and resignation categories are provisional pending the official Mass Mobilization baseline and human review.
open_questions: Verify the official category mapping against the original codebook and Coding Procedure.
